Body.Content: Cloud App Discovery, a module of Azure Active Directory Premium is generally available and accessible via the Microsoft Azure portal. It can provide your IT department with visibility into all your organization’s business and consumer cloud apps. That makes it easier than ever to discover shadow IT in your organization, including details on usage patterns and any users accessing your cloud applications. For even better management and control, your IT teams can then integrate their preferred applications with Azure Active Directory. For more information, please visit the Cloud App Discovery page. There is no additional charge for this feature.
Body.Markdown:
Cloud App Discovery, a module of Azure Active Directory Premium is generally available and accessible via the Microsoft Azure portal . It can provide your IT department with visibility into all your organization’s business and consumer cloud apps. That makes it easier than ever to discover shadow IT in your organization, including details on usage patterns and any users accessing your cloud applications. For even better management and control, your IT teams can then integrate their preferred applications with Azure Active Directory.

For more information, please visit the Cloud App Discovery page. There is no additional charge for this feature.
